changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]Streaming[/COLOR]
-New TV Shows > Streaming, with the same platforms as Movies > Streaming. Each one lists the series you can watch on it today, not only its own productions, with JustWatch data through TMDb. Only series with 50 votes or more on TMDb are listed, and MUBI and TCM stay in Movies only. It can be turned off in Settings with TV Streaming Services.
-New platform: OnDemandKorea, with Korean dramas, shows and movies in Movies and TV Shows > Streaming.
[COLOR fffdb515]Tools[/COLOR]
-Test TV networks is now Test networks and streaming platforms. It also measures every platform of Movies and TV Shows > Streaming, and flags the ones with an empty or short list or a wrong ID.
[COLOR fffdb515]Logos[/COLOR]
-Every logo in Networks, Streaming and Originals now ships with the add-on: sharp, the same size and shown at once, with nothing to download. The external logo pack on GitHub is no longer used.
-New logos for Apple TV+, Paramount Network, HBO, ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, FX, Showtime, History, Cartoon Network, Adult Swim, BBC One, BBC Two, ITV, Channel 4, Sky Atlantic, AT-X and OnDemandKorea, and a new add-on icon. Paramount+ and Paramount Network, and HBO and HBO Max, are now easy to tell apart.
-The same brand shows the same logo in every menu: Peacock and AMC in Networks, and Amazon, Hulu and Netflix in Originals.
